blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.fulfillmentSet` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method deletes a fulfillment set. It sends a request to the
[Delete Fulfillment Set](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#fulfillment-sets\_deletefulfillmentsetsid)
API route.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the item that was deleted.

children.name: object
children.description: The type of the item that was deleted.

children.name: deleted
children.description: Whether the item was deleted successfully.

[Add Service Zone](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#fulfillment-sets\_postfulfillmentsetsidservicezones)
